svg.aria-label: A keyboard from C4 to C5. C4 is marked with a filled circle (lower voice) and E4 with a light square (upper voice). Three prompts: play C4 alone, play E4 alone, play both together. No interval name is given.
svg.title: Two notes, two voices: C4 and E4

g.text: These are actions for your own keyboard.
How to read this graphic: Find C4 (the
circle) and E4 (the square) on the keyboard.
The three prompts underneath are things to do
on your own keyboard: play the lower note,
play the upper note, then play both. The
